about: Fifteen Days v6, second round: Bai at the table in the stern menu shot; Zei pulling up a chair as the robot brings the menus (owner's comments on coverage-v5, 2026-10-18). DRAFTED prompts.

jobs.prompt: Add the young woman from picture 2 sitting on a chair at the far side of the same wooden table, between the two young men in the middle distance, looking down at a glowing menu in her hands: warm brown skin, shaved sides, tall magenta ponytail, lime-green vest, tattooed arms. She is seated at her real size, drawn once. Picture 1's drawing, colours, camera, framing and crop stay exactly the same; the young man in the orange jacket seen from behind on the left and the tall young man in the cream tunic stay exactly as they are. Exactly three people. No letters or numbers anywhere.
